description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named DeviceAdapter for rendering a list of smart home devices within an Android app. It includes a nested ViewHolder class for managing individual device card views, handling focus, key events (like DPAD and Enter), and toggling device states visually and logically.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying device cards with support for focus and key events, allowing toggling device states.

classes.name: DeviceViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual device card view elements, handling UI updates and input events.

methods.name: DeviceAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of devices and toggle callback.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DeviceViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices.

methods.name: DeviceViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a Device object to the view, setting up UI and input handlers.

methods.name: updateCardState
methods.description: Updates the visual appearance of the device card based on its power state.
